title: Built an Emacs interface for br and bv
description:
## Goal

Deliver an Emacs 29+ package for browsing, triaging, creating, updating, and
inspecting Beads issues through the documented `br` and `bv` structured
interfaces.

## Success Criteria

- Provide discoverable list, detail, triage, planning, mutation, and diagnostic
  commands.
- Invoke `br` and `bv` through safe argument lists and tolerate additive JSON
  fields.
- Pass byte compilation, Checkdoc, package-lint, ERT, live smoke, Markdown, and
  whitespace checks.
- Include package metadata, installation instructions, architecture notes, and
  contribution guidance.
acceptance_criteria: The package provides a discoverable interactive UI, safe subprocess integration, automated ERT coverage, package metadata, documentation, and passing quality gates.
close_reason: Delivered and validated the Emacs 29+ br and bv interface

title: Defined the Emacs package architecture
description: Define the public commands, data model, subprocess boundary, buffers, customization points, and Emacs 29 compatibility contract.
acceptance_criteria: A written implementation contract covers list, detail, triage, mutation, refresh, error handling, and package structure.

comments.author: dajobe
comments.text: Architecture contract recorded in docs/architecture.md after reviewing local br 0.2.22 and bv 0.19.0 machine-readable command surfaces.

title: Implemented structured br and bv process integration
description: Implement safe argv-based asynchronous or synchronous command execution, JSON decoding, workspace discovery, version checks, and actionable errors.
acceptance_criteria: Emacs invokes br and bv without a shell, parses documented JSON envelopes, preserves stderr, and exposes reusable internal APIs.
close_reason: Implemented and verified structured process integration

title: Implemented the interactive Beads major mode
description: Build an Emacs 29+ tabulated issue browser and detail workflow with refresh, filtering, triage, navigation, and guarded mutations.
acceptance_criteria: Users can open a repository, browse and inspect issues, invoke triage, create and update issues, and discover commands through menus and key bindings.
close_reason: Implemented and live-validated the interactive Emacs interface

title: Added automated tests and fixtures
description: Add ERT tests for JSON normalization, command construction, rendering, workspace behavior, mutation prompts, and failures without requiring live Beads binaries.
acceptance_criteria: Focused and full test commands pass on Emacs 29+, including byte compilation and regression coverage for subprocess boundaries.
close_reason: Added and passed 48 ERT regression tests

title: Added package documentation and quality automation
description: Add README usage, installation, customization, contribution notes, package metadata, Make targets, and lint or compilation automation.
acceptance_criteria: A new user can install and use the package from the README, and documented Make targets run all supported checks.
close_reason: Added and validated package documentation and quality automation
